status: Approved article-specific conceptual illustrations; Key West revised after historical validation
key_west_validation: Earlier fort had two tiers of enclosed gun rooms and rooftop artillery, stood offshore, and was later reduced; image remains an interpretive reconstruction.

images.title: Living From the Lagoon

images.title: The Watermen of Sebastian

images.title: Florida’s Cow Cavalry
images.alt: Mounted Florida cowhunters guide small, lean Cracker cattle through pine and palmetto country.

images.title: Salt Makers of the Gulf Coast

images.title: Enoch Daniel Jr.
